main_text.p: Προσκυλίω advolvo. Fut. ίσω. P. ἀσ. προσκυλι-κα. a. 1. act. προσκυλίσας, ας ε. part. a. 1. προσκυ-λίσας, αντ. ὁ.

Προσκυνέω ῶ proprie ofculor q. d. adofculor 1.Reg.19. 18. πᾶν γόνυ ὃ οὐ προσεκύνησε, &c. item adoro usitatè cum Accuf. Johan.4.23. sæpius cum Dat. in V. & N.T. juxta verbi Hebraici השתחוה Syntaxin, & quoties id fit, per Hebraismum id fieri tenendum est. imperf. προσεκύνουν ἦν. F. ήσω. a. 1. προσκυνῆσαι. P. προσκεκύνηκα (ex προσς & κυνέω pro κυνω vel κυέω per epenthesin ν νὰ osculor.) Est vero ex Hebraica phrasi τὸ προσκυνεῖν, πίπτειν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον procidere in faciem, Matth.26. 67. Luc.17.16.
Προσλαλέω ῶ alloquor cum Dat. Fut. ήσω. aor. 1. act. προσελάλησα. P. προσλελάληκα. a.1. infin. προσλαλῆσαι.

Προσλαμβάνω accipio praterea, assumo, excipio, accipio cum Accuf. Actor.28.2. aor. 2. προσελαβον. aor. 2. infin. προσλαβεῖν. προσλαβεῖν τροφῆς Act.27.34. cum Genit. assumere aliquid cibi. prout Galli dicunt prendre du pain. Scilicet non omnem cibum assumpserunt. Est ergo hæc Syntaxis (ut illi opinantur) elliptica & subauditur μέρος, seu μόριον particula. Verum enim verò ego sentio non

page.notes: Right page only. Greek and some abbreviated Latin forms are read with doubt; the Greek in the lexicon entries may contain small errors. Catchword and signature not visible. The Hebrew word השתחוה is printed as a whole in the Hebrew line. The page-end mark "R" below the text is a signature-like mark, not transcribed.
